name: TEV-LINK-v0
statement: Frozen BEFORE any fresh linker evaluation set is built or opened. Not to be modified on the basis of the already-viewed unseen_alias / unseen_concept sets.

decision_model.options: A-E = top-5 candidates in BGE rank order (no reshuffling) + NONE
decision_model.none_definition: None of the candidates is the same ingredient as the mention.
decision_model.state: Recipe ingredient mention: <mention> (mention only, no sentence context)
decision_model.instruction: Which ingredient from the ledger is the same ingredient as the recipe mention "<mention>"? Choose NONE if no candidate is the same ingredient.
decision_model.candidate_text: canonical name + up to 3 aliases ('also called: ...')
decision_model.settings: service defaults (deterministic: identical probabilities on 3 repeats), no temperature override, top-K = 5
